import random, sys, ipaddress

def rand_addr(rng, style=None):
    if style is None:
        style = rng.choice(['plain','plain','plain','v4emb','upper','low','random'])
    if style == 'v4emb':
        a = rng.randrange(1 << 64)
        lo = rng.randrange(1 << 32)
        s = '%x::%d.%d.%d.%d' % (a >> 32 if False else 0, 0,0,0,0)  # placeholder
        # construct from bytes
        b = a.to_bytes(8,'big') + lo.to_bytes(4,'big') + b'\x00\x00\x00\x00'
        b = (a.to_bytes(8,'big') + lo.to_bytes(8,'big'))
        ip = ipaddress.IPv6Address(int.from_bytes(b,'big'))
        # textual ipv4-embedded form
        hi = ':'.join('%x' % int.from_bytes(b[i:i+2],'big') for i in range(0,12,2))
        return '%s:%d.%d.%d.%d' % (hi, b[12], b[13], b[14], b[15])
    a = rng.randrange(1 << 128)
    s = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(a))
    if style == 'upper':
        s = s.upper()
    elif style == 'low':
        # exploded form with leading zeros
        h = '%032x' % a
        s = ':'.join(h[i:i+4] for i in range(0,32,4))
    return s

def gen_fib(rng, n, path, maxlen=64):
    lines = []
    used = set()
    tries = 0
    while len(lines) < n and tries < n * 30 + 50:
        tries += 1
        plen = rng.choice([0,1,2,3,7,16,24,32,48,63,64,64,rng.randrange(0, maxlen+1)])
        a = rng.randrange(1 << 128)
        up = a >> 64
        key = up & (~((1 << (64-plen))-1) & ((1<<64)-1)) if plen else 0
        if (key, plen) in used:
            continue
        used.add((key, plen))
        hop = rng.choice([0, 4294967295, rng.randrange(1 << 32)])
        addr = rand_addr(rng)
        # rebuild addr from key to ensure normalization exercises
        if rng.random() < 0.6:
            low = rng.randrange(1 << 64)
            hostbits = (1 << (64 - plen)) - 1 if plen else 0
            full = (key << 64) | (rng.randrange(1 << 64) & hostbits) | low
            addr = rand_addr_from_int(rng, full)
        sep = rng.choice([' ', '  ', '\t', ' \t '])
        hopstr = rng.choice([str(hop), '%010d' % hop, '%d' % hop])
        lenstr = rng.choice([str(plen), '%02d' % plen, '%03d' % plen])
        lines.append('%s/%s%s%s' % (addr, lenstr, sep, hopstr))
    text = ''
    for l in lines:
        if rng.random() < 0.06:
            text += rng.choice(['\n', '   \n', '\t\n', '\r\n', ' \t\r\n'])
        eol = rng.choice(['\n', '\n', '\n', '\r\n'])
        text += l + eol
    if rng.random() < 0.2 and text.endswith('\n'):
        text = text[:-1]
    open(path, 'w', newline='').write(text)
    return len(lines)

def rand_addr_from_int(rng, v):
    style = rng.choice(['std','std','upper','exploded','v4'])
    if style == 'v4' and (v & ((1<<32)-1)) is not None:
        b = v.to_bytes(16,'big')
        hi = ':'.join('%x' % int.from_bytes(b[i:i+2],'big') for i in range(0,12,2))
        return '%s:%d.%d.%d.%d' % (hi, b[12], b[13], b[14], b[15])
    if style == 'exploded':
        h = '%032x' % v
        return ':'.join(h[i:i+4] for i in range(0,32,4))
    s = str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(v))
    return s.upper() if style == 'upper' else s

def gen_trace(rng, n, path, keys=None):
    lines = []
    for i in range(n):
        if keys and rng.random() < 0.5:
            k = rng.choice(keys)
            v = (k << 64) | rng.randrange(1 << 64)
            # sometimes bump by +-1 to hit boundaries
            if rng.random() < 0.3:
                v = max(0, min((1<<128)-1, v + rng.choice([-1,1,-2,2])))
        else:
            v = rng.randrange(1 << 128)
        lines.append(rand_addr_from_int(rng, v))
    text = ''
    for l in lines:
        if rng.random() < 0.05:
            text += rng.choice(['\n', '  \n', '\r\n'])
        ind = rng.random()
        pad_l = rng.choice(['', ' ', '\t', '  \t']) if ind < 0.15 else ''
        pad_r = rng.choice(['', ' ', '\t', '\r', ' \r']) if ind < 0.3 else ''
        text += pad_l + l + pad_r + rng.choice(['\n','\n','\r\n'])
    if rng.random() < 0.2 and text.endswith('\n'):
        text = text[:-1]
    open(path, 'w', newline='').write(text)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    seed = int(sys.argv[1]); nfib = int(sys.argv[2]); ntrace = int(sys.argv[3])
    fibp = sys.argv[4]; trp = sys.argv[5]
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    n = gen_fib(rng, nfib, fibp)
    keys = None
    gen_trace(rng, ntrace, trp)
    print(n)
